scope.reason: Web-interface agent acting on DOM elements (click/type) in interactive MiniWoB environments; training method for the policy.

Final scope decision (edge): Pumice is an agent that perceives app GUIs through the Android accessibility tree and executes recorded/generalised procedures on real third-party apps; its contribution changes the instruction/clarification and knowledge part of the loop (concept grounding via GUI demonstration and agent-initiated questions). It is not pure API, UI-code generation or robotics, so it meets EVIDENCE.md scope. It is an edge case because evidence is an HCI usability study of human+agent authoring rather than autonomous task success; claim_type system_method is kept and E items are judged against that usability claim.
Mobile GUI instruction grounding model and datasets usable as a CUA component; offline evaluation.
Web agent that grounds instructions to DOM element actions and executes them in a browser runtime.

Final scope decision (edge, kept): the policy observes a text rendering of live web pages and issues sequential browser commands (search, click link IDs, find, scroll, back, quote; agg:G-A07). That is a browser operation surface, so it is not excluded as a pure API/function-calling agent, and the contribution (environment + BC/RM/RL/best-of-n training of the browsing policy) is an agent training method evaluated in an interactive environment. Edge because the task is read-only QA (agg:G-A08) and outcomes are human-preference judgments, not execution-checked task completion; claim_type system_method is kept. Its score must not be read as evidence of GUI task-execution competence.
